definition: a large grand house where a king lives
description: A red-haired woman in a bright green raincoat opens a series of ever grander gates. First a low white picket gate in a cottage flower garden, then a heavy wooden farm gate with sheep grazing behind it, then tall black iron gates opening onto an avenue of clipped hedges. Finally she grips a huge gold-painted gate and looks through it at an enormous stately palace, then turns to the camera smiling with the palace and its wide gravel forecourt behind her.
